description: This file defines a PHP class WorkShiftDecorator that serves as a decorator for the WorkShift entity, providing formatted start and end times by utilizing traits for ORM and DateTime helpers.

classes.name: WorkShiftDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the WorkShift entity providing formatted start and end times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a WorkShift object.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted start time as a string or null.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted end time as a string or null.
